title: xDrip + blucon + libre does not receive data
symptom: The user reports that xDrip with blucon and Libre 1 does not receive data reliably. Sometimes it receives some data but not enough to pass calibration.
fix: The maintainer suggests trying disabling/enabling 'trust auto connect' and 'use scanning' in xDrip under settings->less common settings->bluetooth options, as one of the four combinations might work.
evidence_quote: Please try disabling/enabling "trust auto connect" and "use scanning" Probably one of the 4 possible combinations should work well.
